summary: Show the installed release tag in fractal --version when the download installer's release receipt matches the binary's embedded commit

rules.detail: No runtime or replication rule changes.

compatibility.detail: Human --version displays the installed release tag and commit when a matching RELEASE.json is present; machine-readable --version --json is unchanged. Nix/Home Manager and missing or invalid receipts retain the baked version and commit.

manual.detail: The download installer writes the receipt automatically after checksum verification, outside the signed app bundle on macOS.

recovery.detail: Old binaries ignore the receipt; replacing a binary with a different commit causes version display to fall back automatically.
